# Bare Bones Mechanics

Bare Bones Mechanics provides basic mobile vehicle maintenance serving the Triad area.

## Primary services
- Oil changes
- Filter replacement
- Battery replacement
- Tire rotation

Other requests are reviewed case by case and are not guaranteed. Complex diagnostics and repairs should be deferred to a certified repair shop or dealer.

## Customer process
Customers submit a service intake form, select a provisional appointment time, receive and approve a quote, and pay through Stripe or PayPal before the appointment is confirmed.

## Canonical website
https://barebonesmechanics.com
